title: Retrieval-Augmented Generation for Knowledge-Intensive NLP
abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation combines neural text generation with external document retrieval. The method improves factual grounding on knowledge-intensive tasks by conditioning generation on retrieved passages.

title: Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Language Models
abstract: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning adapts large language models by training a small number of task-specific parameters. The approach reduces compute and storage requirements while preserving strong downstream performance.

title: Evaluating Faithfulness in Long-Form Question Answering
abstract: Faithfulness evaluation measures whether generated answers are supported by source documents. We introduce automatic checks and human evaluation protocols for identifying unsupported claims in long-form answers.
